title: Fact Knowledge Layer
subtitle: Extract checkable facts from PDFs, tie each one to the words that support it, and work out whether sources agree, conflict, or only appear to.

title: Two values disagreeing is not the same as two sources contradicting each other
subtitle: Documents differ for good reasons — a different period, basis, scope or unit. Telling a real conflict from an explained one is the whole problem.

callouts.title: Every stage, in order
callouts.body: Chunk, extract, verify each quote against the real page, resolve the entity, fold new metric names into the vocabulary, then link against everything stored.

callouts.title: 0.69 seconds, no API calls
callouts.body: Model responses are committed to the repo, so the pipeline replays offline. A reviewer can run this with no key at all.

title: A fact corroborated across documents, expressed differently
subtitle: Two filings, two years apart, two different scale conventions.

callouts.title: Rs 8,142 Cr  =  Rs 81,415 Mn
callouts.body: The earnings deck writes crore; the annual report writes million. Both normalize to one magnitude, and FY24 resolves to the same interval in each.

callouts.title: Why they agree
callouts.body: Agreement is judged against a tolerance derived from how precisely each figure was written, not an arbitrary threshold.

callouts.title: Every fact points at its source
callouts.body: The model proposes a quote; the system finds it on the actual page before storing the fact. Here it is, highlighted where it came from.

callouts.title: An unfindable quote is rejected
callouts.body: That guard is what turns "the model said so" into "the document says so".

title: A genuine or likely contradiction
subtitle: Same company, same metric, same period — and nothing stated that would explain the gap.

callouts.title: (2,532) against (2,258)
callouts.body: Adjusted EBITDA for FY21, stated twice in one annual report — once in a chart, once in prose — differing by 10.8 per cent.

callouts.title: Reported, not smoothed over
callouts.body: Nine conflicts survive across 511 pages. The first run reported 138; the rest were the system's own errors, each found and fixed.

title: An apparent contradiction explained by context
subtitle: The figures disagree. The documents already say why.

callouts.title: Rs 2,076 Cr against Rs 81,415 Mn
callouts.body: A fortyfold gap that is not a disagreement: one figure covers Q4 FY24, the other the full year containing it.

callouts.title: Periods placed on one timeline
callouts.body: Q4 FY24 and FY24 become intervals, and the system knows one nests inside the other. Reconciled on period, never a contradiction.

title: Extraction failures, measured rather than hidden
subtitle: A rejected fact is written down with a reason, so failure is inspectable instead of invisible.

callouts.title: 155 facts rejected, by cause
callouts.body: "Table association unverifiable" means the model read a column-major table correctly, but the cells do not extract in reading order.

callouts.title: The distinction matters
callouts.body: Separating "the model invented this" from "the model could not see the table" turns a worrying number into a specific engineering problem.

callouts.title: 107 qualifier keys, none declared
callouts.body: Nothing enumerates these. A document that introduces "selling shareholder" or "partner" registers it here, and it takes part in comparison immediately.

title: 3,112 facts · 511 pages · 91% grounded · 629 cross-document links
subtitle: Deterministic rules settle roughly nine in ten comparisons and state their reasoning; only what they cannot settle reaches a model. Runs offline from a committed cache — no API key required.
